title: Student can later deny having submitted the assignment

assumptions: Especially relevant if network metadata or application-layer metadata are observable beyond the strictly necessary recipient.
uncertainty_note: Tree-node id is approximate; context confirms Linkability is applicable to ExternalEntity->Process flows but not the exact node.
